title: Clickety-Clack Cuttlefish
statement: Nestled among sunlit stacks of slate and swaying ribbon-kelp, this pint-sized cephalopod spends its days clicking smooth pebbles of sea glass together like tiny abacus beads. Whenever it discovers a particularly pleasing pattern on the mossy floor, its pearlescent skin ripples with shifting constellations of copper and indigo.
